Name: Mystery Trailer
Author: QueenQuackin
Description:
"And I would have gotten away with it too if it wasn't for you meddling.... farmer?!" 

The mystery trailer replaces the trailer cabin. There is a config for enabling and disabling the retexture, the default is true. New cabin upgrades are now available as well as the AT version!

[b][i][u]To-do Lis[/u][/i][/b]t
> Add upgrade options - Done!
> Add Seasonal Changes
> Add AT version - Done!

[b][i][u]Compatibility

[/u][/i][/b]> This works in multiplayer as long as you all have the mod and have it enabled.
> Android compatibility unknown as I can not test that
> Cp Version is not compatible in saves with other CP retextures of the Trailer Cabin. Nothing will break you just won't see the texture.
> CP version is compatible with Decoratable Cabin by AkiAkumu as it replaces the Trailer Cabin. The AT version is not at the current moment

[b][i][u]Mod Conflicts

[/u][/i][/b]> None that are known other than other CP replacers


[b][i][u]Have an Error?

[/u][/i][/b]Please post a comment with your SMAPI Log otherwise I will not be able to see what is going on.
